description: This Java class 'InterestIncentiveDataValidator' provides validation logic for creating and updating interest incentive data in the Fineract platform. It checks JSON input for required fields, correct values, and supported parameters, throwing exceptions on validation errors.

classes.name: InterestIncentiveDataValidator
classes.description: A Spring component class that validates JSON data for creating and updating interest incentives, ensuring required fields and valid values.

methods.name: validateCreate
methods.description: Validates JSON input for creating an interest incentive, checking for unsupported parameters and required fields.

methods.name: validateIncentiveCreate
methods.description: Performs detailed validation of the JSON element for creating an interest incentive, verifying field values and types.

methods.name: validateUpdate
methods.description: Validates JSON input for updating an interest incentive, including optional fields.

methods.name: validateIncentiveUpdate
methods.description: Performs detailed validation of the JSON element for updating an interest incentive, verifying optional fields and their values.

methods.name: throwExceptionIfValidationWarningsExist
methods.description: Throws a validation exception if any validation errors are present.
